items.cn: enclosure 成为把公田转为私田的法律与经济术语。英国大规模圈地运动在 18 世纪至 19 世纪初达到高峰。

items.en: Engineering adopted enclosure for protective housings, and ecology for experimental pens. In both, the word keeps its literal function: a boundary that controls what crosses it.
items.cn: 工程学采用 enclosure 指防护外壳，生态学指实验围隔。两者都保留字面功能：控制什么可以越过的边界。

items.en: Email largely replaced the postal sense with attachment, but legal and formal writing still uses enclosure for documents sent with a letter, often abbreviated 'encl.'
items.cn: 电子邮件在很大程度上用 attachment 取代了邮政义，但法律与正式写作仍用 enclosure 指随信文件，常缩写为 encl.。

note.en: The first group separates same-root words built on claudere from one another; the second group separates kinds of bounded space and enclosed item.
note.cn: 第一组区分建立在 claudere 上的同源词；第二组区分各类有界空间与被封入之物。

entries.definition: the act of closing or the state of being closed, from Latin clausura. It names the shutting, not the fenced plot.
entries.definitionCN: 关闭的动作或状态，源自拉丁语 clausura。它命名“关上”，而非被围的地块。

entries.definition: to reveal what was hidden. Dis- 'un-' + claudere 'shut' means to un-shut, the exact opposite of enclosing.
entries.definitionCN: 揭示隐藏之物。dis-“解除”+ claudere“关闭”意为“打开”，与 enclosing 正好相反。

entries.definition: to contain as part of a whole. In- + claudere gives 'shut in', which is close to enclose but usually figurative: members of a set, not land.
entries.definitionCN: 作为整体的一部分包含。in- + claudere 给出“关在里面”，与 enclose 接近，但通常抽象：集合的成员，而非土地。

entries.definition: a small fenced area for animals. It is more specific and usually smaller than an enclosure.
entries.definitionCN: 圈养动物的小围栏。它比 enclosure 更具体，通常也更小。

entries.definition: an area with buildings enclosed by a wall. It stresses the buildings inside rather than the boundary.
entries.definitionCN: 由围墙围起的一片建筑区域。它强调里面的建筑，而非边界。

entries.definition: a file or item sent with a message. It is the modern replacement for the postal sense of enclosure.
entries.definitionCN: 随消息发送的文件或物品。它是 enclosure 邮政义的现代替代词。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: en- + close, Latin claudere, the -ure result suffix, and the fixed historical phrase enclosure movement.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：en- + close、拉丁语 claudere、表结果的 -ure 后缀，以及固定历史说法 enclosure movement。

normal.en: en- 'in' + close: enclose means 'shut in', and -ure makes it either the shutting or the shut-in place.
normal.cn: en-“在内”+ close：enclose 意为“关进去”，-ure 使它既可指“关”的动作，也可指“被关住的地方”。

normal.en: Latin claudere also gives closure and disclose — one shuts, the other un-shuts.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 claudere 还给出 closure 与 disclose——一个关上，一个打开。

normal.en: In a letter, the enclosure is whatever is shut inside the envelope with the note.
normal.cn: 在信件里，enclosure 就是和便条一起被封进信封的东西。

normal.en: An enclosure movement is not about fences as scenery; it is about who is allowed to use land.
normal.cn: 圈地运动不是关于栅栏风景，而是关于谁被允许使用土地。

normal.en: An ecological enclosure is a controlled 'inside' used to measure what happens outside it.
normal.cn: 生态围隔是一个受控的“内部”，用来测量外部发生的事。

abstract.en: Every enclosure draws two worlds and a rule for crossing between them.
abstract.cn: 每一道围合都划出两个世界，以及一条穿越其间的规则。

abstract.en: A boundary that keeps animals in also keeps something else out; protection and exclusion are the same wall seen from two sides.
abstract.cn: 把动物关住的边界同时也把别的东西挡在外面；保护与排斥是同一堵墙的两面。

abstract.en: What is enclosed becomes legible: a measured plot, a counted flock, a listed attachment.
abstract.cn: 被围起来的东西变得可读：一块可测量的地、一群可计数的羊、一份列出的附件。

examples.en: The enclosure of the wetland prevented further damage to the nesting birds.
examples.cn: 对湿地的围护防止了巢鸟受到进一步干扰。

examples.en: The eighteenth-century enclosure movement changed patterns of land ownership across England.
examples.cn: 18 世纪的圈地运动改变了英格兰的土地所有权格局。

examples.en: Please sign the letter and return it with its enclosures.
examples.cn: 请在信上签字，并连同附件一并寄回。

dict_mnemonic.text: “en 克漏，惹”——把漏洞围起来，惹得外人进不去 → enclosure 围场、围住

root: en-（在内）+ close（关闭，经古法语 clos 源自拉丁语 claudere“关闭”）+ -ure（行为／结果名词后缀）；字面义“关在里面”，核心是“用边界分出内外”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of enclosure all draw a boundary: around land, around animals, around a letter's contents, around a machine, around an experimental plot. Sometimes the word names the act, sometimes the bounded space, sometimes the barrier itself — the -ure suffix permits all three.
sensesIntro.cn: enclosure 的八个义项都画出一条边界：围住土地、围住动物、围住信件内容、围住机器、围住实验样地。这个词有时命名动作，有时命名有界空间，有时命名屏障本身——-ure 后缀允许这三种读法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fence line that separates an inside with one rule from an outside with another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条栅栏线，把一种规则的“内”与另一种规则的“外”分开。

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE LINE: enclosing is the raising of a barrier, and the barrier itself is the boundary between in and out.
branches.cn: 动作与界线：围合是竖起屏障，而屏障本身就是内外边界。

branches.en: LAND AND LIVESTOCK: a bounded field or pen turns open space into a managed, countable unit.
branches.cn: 土地与牲畜：有界的田地或围栏把开放空间变成可管理的、可计数的单位。

branches.en: PROTECTED INSIDE: a letter's contents and a machine's parts are shut in so that they stay together and stay clean.
branches.cn: 受保护的内部：信件内容与机器部件被关在里面，以保持完整与清洁。

branches.en: HISTORY: the fence becomes a legal exclusion, turning shared use into private right.
branches.cn: 历史：栅栏变成法律排斥，把共用转为私有权利。

branches.en: SCIENCE: a controlled enclosure isolates a plot so that a difference can be measured.
branches.cn: 科学：受控围隔隔离出一块样地，使差异可被测量。

intro.en: Enclosure is a transparent -ure noun on the verb enclose, which itself is en- + close from Latin claudere. The affix set shows the verb, participles, the -ure noun, and same-root words with different prefixes.
intro.cn: enclosure 是在动词 enclose 上的透明 -ure 名词，而 enclose 本身是 en- + close，源自拉丁语 claudere。词缀组展示动词、分词、-ure 名词，以及不同前缀的同源词。

latinIntro.en: Latin claudere 'to shut' yields clausus, clausura, and the French family clos / enclore / enclosure. English also built disclose and include on the same root with different prefixes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 claudere“关闭”产生 clausus、clausura，以及法语词族 clos / enclore / enclosure。英语也在同一词根上用不同前缀造出 disclose 与 include。

items.meaning: the act of enclosing or the enclosed space
items.meaningCN: 围住；围场（-ure 表行为或结果）
items.example: The enclosure held twelve sheep.
items.exampleCN: 这个围场养了十二只羊。

items.meaning: to surround or shut something in
items.meaningCN: 围住；把……封入（en- + close）
items.example: Please enclose a copy of your ID.
items.exampleCN: 请随附身份证复印件。

items.meaningCN: 被围住的；随附的（-ed 分词）
items.example: The enclosed garden is open to visitors.
items.exampleCN: 这座封闭式花园对游客开放。

items.meaningCN: 围合的；包围的（-ing 分词形容词）
items.example: An enclosing wall kept the wind out.
items.exampleCN: 一道围墙把风挡在外面。

items.meaning: the act of closing or a shutting down
items.meaningCN: 关闭；停业（同源不同构词）
items.example: The closure of the factory cost many jobs.
items.exampleCN: 工厂关闭让许多人失去工作。

items.meaningCN: 揭露；公开（dis- + close）
items.example: The company disclosed the test results.
items.exampleCN: 公司公开了测试结果。

items.meaning: to shut in, contain as part of a whole
items.meaningCN: 包含（in- + claudere）
items.example: The price includes delivery.
items.exampleCN: 价格包含配送。

items.meaningCN: 幽闭恐惧（claustrum + -phobia）
items.example: He avoids lifts because of claustrophobia.
items.exampleCN: 他因幽闭恐惧而避免乘电梯。

definition_zh: 鼓励；激励；鼓舞人心的事物；扶持；促进；（法律）怂恿、助长
definition_en: the act of giving someone confidence or hope; words or actions that inspire effort; support that helps an activity develop; something that gives hope; (law) the act of urging or aiding someone to do something, including something unlawful
core_image: 一只手放在另一个人的肩上，把“你不行”轻轻压成“你可以试试”
scene: 教练在球员失误后没有责备，只拍了拍他的背。After the miss the coach does not scold; he pats the player's back and says to take the next shot, and that is encouragement.
sceneCN: 这里 encouragement 是「鼓励」（第 1 个义项：给予信心或希望）；句意：球员失误后教练没有责备，只拍拍他的背说下一球照打，这就是鼓励。图中可辨识物件：球场边线、教练的手、球员低下的头、记分牌。

pos.zh: 鼓励；激励；鼓舞人心的事物（不可数；可数时指一句句鼓励）
扶持；促进；（法律）怂恿、助长（较专业用法）

senses.title: The act of giving confidence
senses.definition: the act of giving someone confidence, hope, or courage to continue
senses.definitionCN: 给予某人继续下去的信心、希望或勇气的行为
senses.example: A word of encouragement from her tutor kept her writing through the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 导师一句鼓励的话让她整个冬天都在写作。
senses.why: Encouragement is encourage + -ment, and encourage is en- 'make' + courage. Courage comes from Old French corage, from Latin cor 'heart'. The noun therefore names the act of putting heart into someone.
senses.whyCN: encouragement 是 encourage + -ment，而 encourage 是 en-“使”+ courage。courage 来自古法语 corage，源自拉丁语 cor“心”。因此这个名词命名的是“把心放进某人心里”的动作。

senses.title: Words or actions that inspire
senses.definition: a specific remark, gesture, or act that raises someone's morale
senses.definitionCN: 提升某人士气的具体话语、举动或行为
senses.example: Her note was a small encouragement pinned above his desk.
senses.exampleCN: 她写的便条是一份小小的鼓励，钉在他书桌上方。
senses.why: The -ment noun can be countable when it names individual tokens of support: a note, a nod, a round of applause. These are the visible units through which the abstract act reaches a person.
senses.whyCN: 当 -ment 名词命名一份份具体的支持时，它可以可数：一张便条、一个点头、一阵掌声。这些是抽象行为抵达个人的可见单位。

senses.title: Support that helps something develop
senses.definition: active support given to an activity, industry, or practice so that it can grow
senses.definitionCN: 给予活动、产业或做法的积极支持，使其得以成长
senses.example: The tax break is an encouragement for small publishers.
senses.exampleCN: 这项税收减免是对小型出版社的扶持。
senses.why: Here the receiver is not a person's morale but an activity's growth. Policy language uses encouragement for mild, non-compulsory promotion, softer than a mandate and stronger than mere permission.
senses.whyCN: 这里的接受者不是个人士气，而是活动的成长。政策语言用 encouragement 指温和、非强制的推动，比强制令软，比单纯许可强。

senses.title: An incentive or inducement
senses.definition: something that makes a person more willing to do something, often by offering a reward
senses.definitionCN: 使某人更愿意做某事的事物，常通过提供奖励
senses.example: The prize serves as an encouragement to finish the course.
senses.exampleCN: 这个奖项起着激励人完成课程的作用。
senses.why: This sense shades from moral support into material inducement: the encouragement is a reason, not a pat on the back. Context decides whether the word is warm or transactional.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项从精神支持滑向物质诱导：encouragement 是一个理由，而不是拍拍背。语境决定这个词是温暖的还是交易性的。

senses.title: Legal urging or abetting
senses.definition: the act of urging, inciting, or assisting another person to commit an act, especially an offence
senses.definitionCN: 怂恿、煽动或协助他人实施某行为，尤指违法行为
senses.example: The court found that his encouragement of the breach made him liable.
senses.exampleCN: 法院认定他对该违法行为的怂恿使其负有责任。
senses.why: Law exposes the dark side of 'putting heart into': the same act that strengthens resolve can strengthen resolve to do wrong. This technical sense is neutral in form but carries liability.
senses.whyCN: 法律揭示了“把心放进去”的阴暗面：增强决心的同一行为，也可能增强做坏事的决心。这个专业义在形式上中性，却带法律责任。

senses.title: Morale-raising in sport or military life
senses.titleCN: 体育或军队中的士气鼓舞
senses.definition: the boosting of a group's spirit before or during a contest or operation
senses.definitionCN: 在比赛或行动前或期间提振群体精神
senses.example: The captain's encouragement kept the team together after two defeats.
senses.exampleCN: 两场失利后，队长的鼓励让队伍没有散掉。
senses.why: Group settings shift the word from individual to collective morale. The encouragement is addressed to 'us', and success is measured by persistence rather than by any single person's feelings.
senses.whyCN: 群体场景把这个词从个人转向集体士气。鼓励的对象是“我们”，成功以坚持来衡量，而不是某个人的感受。

senses.title: Positive reinforcement in teaching
senses.definition: support given to a learner to increase a desired behaviour or effort
senses.definitionCN: 给予学习者支持，以增加期望行为或努力
senses.example: The teacher's encouragement was specific: 'your paragraph order is clearer now'.
senses.exampleCN: 老师的鼓励很具体：“你的段落顺序现在更清楚了。”
senses.why: Education borrows the word for reinforcement. Specific encouragement names what improved, so it functions as feedback; vague praise can raise mood without teaching anything.
senses.whyCN: 教育借这个词指正向强化。具体的鼓励点明改进之处，因此起反馈作用；空泛的表扬能提升情绪，却不教任何东西。

senses.title: Something that gives hope
senses.definition: a sign or development that makes people feel more hopeful about the future
senses.definitionCN: 让人对未来更有希望的迹象或进展
senses.example: The first harvest after the drought was an encouragement to the whole village.
senses.exampleCN: 旱灾后的第一次收成让整个村子受到鼓舞。
senses.why: This sense makes the word almost a countable 'source of hope'. The encouragement is an event, not a person's act, which shows how far the -ment noun can travel from its verbal base.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项几乎把词变成可数的“希望来源”。encouragement 是一个事件，而非某人的行为，显示 -ment 名词能离动词底座走多远。

intro.en: Encouragement is a native English -ment noun on encourage, which joins en- 'make' to courage. Courage itself is Old French corage, from Latin cor 'heart'. The word's literal history is therefore 'the act of putting heart into someone'.
intro.cn: encouragement 是在 encourage 上的英语 -ment 名词，encourage 把 en-“使”加在 courage 上。courage 本身是古法语 corage，源自拉丁语 cor“心”。因此这个词的字面历史是“把心放进某人心里”的行为。

items.en: Latin cor (genitive cordis) meant 'heart', and also 'mind, spirit, courage'. It is the source of cordial, record, concord, and the French-derived courage.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cor（属格 cordis）意为“心”，也指“心智、精神、勇气”。它是 cordial、record、concord 以及法语来源 courage 的根源。

items.en: Old French corage meant 'heart, innermost feeling, bravery'. The -age suffix turned cor into a mass noun for a quality of the heart.
items.cn: 古法语 corage 意为“心、内心感受、勇敢”。-age 后缀把 cor 变成表心之品质的集合名词。

items.en: English borrowed courage in the fourteenth century. The verb encourage, literally 'put courage into', is recorded in the fifteenth century; the exact first use is approximate.
items.cn: 英语于 14 世纪借入 courage。动词 encourage 字面为“把勇气放进去”，记录于 15 世纪；确切首用年代为大致估计。

items.en: Encouragement appears in the sixteenth century as the action noun. Early uses include both moral support and the milder sense of 'promoting' an activity.
items.cn: encouragement 于 16 世纪作为动作名词出现。早期用法既包括精神支持，也包括“促进某项活动”的较温和义。

items.en: Legal writing developed the technical sense of urging or abetting another's act. The same structure that gives moral support can also give unlawful resolve.
items.cn: 法律写作发展出“怂恿或助长他人行为”的专业义。给予精神支持的同一结构，也能给予违法的决心。

items.en: Psychology and education adopted encouragement for positive reinforcement, often stressing that it should name a specific improvement rather than offer vague praise.
items.cn: 心理学与教育学采用 encouragement 指正向强化，常强调它应点明具体改进，而非给空泛表扬。

note.en: The first group separates courage-family words from one another; the second group separates ways of giving support.
note.cn: 第一组区分 courage 词族内部的关系；第二组区分给予支持的不同方式。

entries.definition: to give someone confidence or urge them on. It is the verb behind the -ment noun.
entries.definitionCN: 给予信心或催促向前。它是 -ment 名词背后的动词。

entries.definition: the ability to face fear or difficulty. It is the heart-quality that encouragement tries to supply.
entries.definitionCN: 面对恐惧或困难的能力。它是 encouragement 试图提供的“心之品质”。

entries.definition: the act of taking away confidence. Dis- reverses encourage, and -ment makes the matching noun.
entries.definitionCN: 夺走信心的行为。dis- 反转 encourage，-ment 造出对应的名词。

entries.definition: help or backing given to a person or activity. It is broader and often more practical than encouragement.
entries.definitionCN: 给予人或活动的帮助与支持。它比 encouragement 更宽泛，也常更实际。

entries.definition: the reason or drive that makes someone act. Encouragement comes from outside; motivation is the inner state it hopes to produce.
entries.definitionCN: 促使人行动的理由或内驱力。encouragement 来自外部；motivation 是它希望产生的内在状态。

entries.definition: words that remove worry rather than spur effort. Reassurance calms fear; encouragement adds courage for action.
entries.definitionCN: 消除担忧的话语。reassurance 安抚恐惧；encouragement 增添行动的勇气。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: en- + courage, Latin cor 'heart', the pairs encourage / discouragement, and the fixed phrase words of encouragement.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：en- + courage、拉丁语 cor“心”、encourage / discouragement 这一对，以及固定说法 words of encouragement。

normal.en: en- 'make' + courage: encourage literally puts heart into someone.
normal.cn: en-“使”+ courage：encourage 字面就是把心放进别人心里。

normal.en: Courage comes from Latin cor 'heart', the same root as cordial and record.
normal.cn: courage 来自拉丁语 cor“心”，与 cordial、record 同根。

normal.en: Add -ment and the verb becomes the act: encouragement is the putting-in of heart.
normal.cn: 加 -ment，动词变成行为：encouragement 就是“把心放进去”这件事。

normal.en: Its opposite is discouragement, built with the same -ment on the same verb.
normal.cn: 它的反义是 discouragement，在同一个动词上用同一个 -ment 构成。

normal.en: Words of encouragement is the standard phrase; concrete praise works better than vague praise.
normal.cn: words of encouragement 是标准说法；具体的表扬比空泛的表扬有效。

abstract.en: Courage is borrowed, not owned: encouragement is a loan of heart until the person can supply their own.
abstract.cn: 勇气是可借的，不是被占有的：鼓励是把心借给对方，直到他能自己供给。

abstract.en: The same word that strengthens resolve can strengthen resolve to do harm — law reads the direction, not the warmth.
abstract.cn: 增强决心的同一个词也能增强做坏事的决心——法律看方向，不看温度。

abstract.en: Encouragement works by describing a real improvement; vague warmth evaporates without changing behaviour.
abstract.cn: 鼓励靠描述真实改进起作用；空泛的温暖会蒸发，不改变行为。

examples.en: A few words of encouragement from his coach changed how he approached the final lap.
examples.cn: 教练几句鼓励的话改变了他跑最后一圈的方式。

examples.en: The scheme offers encouragement, not a requirement, for firms to publish their data.
examples.cn: 该方案对企业公开数据是鼓励而非要求。

examples.en: The court treated his encouragement of the theft as a form of liability.
examples.cn: 法院把他对盗窃的怂恿视为一种责任。

dict_mnemonic.text: “因卡瑞，只因门特”——因为他卡住了，只因门口有人拍了拍他 → encouragement 鼓励

root: en-（使）+ courage（勇气，古法语 corage < 拉丁语 cor“心”）+ -ment（行为名词后缀）；字面义“把心放进某人心里”，核心是“从外部补给他继续行动的勇气”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of encouragement all transfer heart from one place to another: to a person's morale, to a struggling activity, to a learner, to a team, or even — in law — to someone's resolve to do wrong. The direction of the transfer, not the warmth, is what varies.
sensesIntro.cn: encouragement 的八个义项都在把“心”从一个地方转移到另一个地方：给个人士气、给挣扎中的活动、给学习者、给团队，甚至在法律上给某人做坏事的决心。变化的是转移的方向，而不是温度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand on a shoulder that turns 'you can't' into 'try once more'.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手放在肩上，把“你不行”变成“再试一次”。

branches.en: INDIVIDUAL: the act of giving confidence and the small visible tokens — a note, a nod — through which it arrives.
branches.cn: 个人：给予信心的行为，以及便条、点头等使之抵达的可见小单位。

branches.en: ACTIVITY AND INCENTIVE: support is given to an industry or practice, or a reward supplies a reason to act.
branches.cn: 活动与诱因：支持给到产业或做法，或以奖励提供行动理由。

branches.en: LAW: the same strengthening of resolve is redirected toward an unlawful act and becomes liability.
branches.cn: 法律：同样的决心强化被转向违法行为，成为法律责任。

branches.en: COLLECTIVE AND PEDAGOGICAL: morale is raised for a team, and reinforcement is made specific for a learner.
branches.cn: 集体与教学：为团队提振士气，为学习者提供具体的正向强化。

branches.en: SOURCE OF HOPE: an event itself encourages, showing the noun's furthest drift from the verb.
branches.cn: 希望来源：事件本身带来鼓舞，显示该名词离动词最远的漂移。

intro.en: Encouragement is English morphology on a French-derived noun: en- + courage + -ment. The affix set traces that path and includes the negative twin built with dis-.
intro.cn: encouragement 是在法语来源名词上的英语形态：en- + courage + -ment。词缀组追溯这条路径，并包含用 dis- 构成的反义孪生词。

latinIntro.en: Latin cor 'heart' gives cordial, concord, and record; Old French corage gives courage; English adds en- and -ment. The same -ment also builds discouragement, the mirror image.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cor“心”给出 cordial、concord、record；古法语 corage 给出 courage；英语再加 en- 与 -ment。同一个 -ment 也构成镜像词 discouragement。

items.meaning: the act of giving confidence or support
items.meaningCN: 鼓励；激励（-ment 构成行为名词）
items.example: Her encouragement kept him going.
items.exampleCN: 她的鼓励让他坚持下去。

items.meaningCN: 鼓励；促进（字面“放入勇气”）
items.example: The teacher encouraged him to ask questions.
items.exampleCN: 老师鼓励他提问。

items.meaningCN: 令人鼓舞的（-ing 分词形容词）
items.example: The early results are encouraging.
items.exampleCN: 早期结果令人鼓舞。

items.meaning: in a way that gives hope
items.meaningCN: 令人鼓舞地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: She smiled encouragingly.
items.exampleCN: 她鼓励地笑了笑。

items.meaning: the act of taking away confidence
items.meaningCN: 泄气；劝阻（dis- 反向 + -ment）
items.example: Constant criticism becomes discouragement.
items.exampleCN: 持续的批评会变成打击。

items.meaning: the strength to face fear or difficulty
items.meaningCN: 勇气（拉丁 cor“心”）
items.example: It takes courage to admit a mistake.
items.exampleCN: 承认错误需要勇气。

items.meaningCN: 勇敢的（-ous 构成形容词）
items.example: A courageous decision ended the dispute.
items.exampleCN: 一个勇敢的决定结束了争端。

items.meaningCN: 热诚的；亲切的（cor + -ial）
items.example: They exchanged cordial greetings.
items.exampleCN: 他们热诚地互相问候。

latinEntries.meaning: to remember, call back to the heart

definition_zh: 提升；增强；改进措施；增值；（图像、医学）增强处理；（生物、技术）增强；（体育）成绩提升（常指兴奋剂）；（法律）加重情节
definition_en: the act of improving the quality, value, or strength of something; an added improvement; the processing of an image or signal to make it clearer; a genetic or technological augmentation; performance improvement, especially through drugs; (law) an added factor that increases a penalty
core_image: 一只手把台灯调亮一档：画面还是那幅，但细节从暗处浮出来
scene: 摄影师把同一张夜景调高对比度、降噪。The photographer raises the contrast and cuts the noise on the same night shot, and calls it an enhancement that changes nothing in the subject.
sceneCN: 这里 enhancement 是「图像增强处理」（第 3 个义项：通过处理使图像更清晰）；句意：摄影师把同一张夜景调高对比度并降噪，称这只是一次增强处理，没有改变拍摄对象。图中可辨识物件：夜景照片、调色面板、对比度滑杆、摄影师的手。

pos.zh: 提升；增强；改进（可数／不可数视语境）
（图像、技术、生物）增强；（法律）加重情节；（体育）成绩提升（专业义）

collocations.zh: 性能提升；（体育）成绩增强

senses.title: Improving quality or value
senses.definition: the act of making something better in quality, value, or effectiveness
senses.definitionCN: 使某物在质量、价值或效果上变得更好的行为
senses.example: The renovation was mainly an enhancement of light and space.
senses.exampleCN: 这次翻新主要是对采光与空间的提升。
senses.why: Enhancement is enhance + -ment. Enhance came from Old French enhaucier 'to make higher', from Vulgar Latin *inaltiare, built on Latin altus 'high'. The original image is physical height, later transferred to value and quality.
senses.whyCN: enhancement 是 enhance + -ment。enhance 来自古法语 enhaucier“使更高”，源自通俗拉丁语 *inaltiare，建立在拉丁语 altus“高”上。最初意象是物理高度，后来转到价值与质量。

senses.title: An added improvement
senses.definition: a specific feature or change added to something to make it better
senses.definitionCN: 为使某物更好而添加的具体功能或改动
senses.example: The software update brought three small enhancements to the search tool.
senses.exampleCN: 这次软件更新给搜索工具带来三项小改进。
senses.why: When the -ment noun is countable, it names discrete improvements rather than a general process. This is the language of release notes: each item is an enhancement the user can point to.
senses.whyCN: 当 -ment 名词可数时，它命名的是离散的改进项，而非笼统过程。这是发布说明的语言：每一项都是用户能指出的 enhancement。

senses.title: Image or signal enhancement
senses.definition: the processing of an image, recording, or signal to make details clearer or stronger
senses.definitionCN: 对图像、录音或信号进行处理，使细节更清晰或更强
senses.example: The lab used contrast enhancement to make the faint fingerprint visible.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室用对比度增强让微弱的指纹显现。
senses.why: Technology keeps the 'raise' metaphor in a new medium: contrast, brightness, and noise reduction lift a pattern above the background. The noun names a processing step, not a change in the original object.
senses.whyCN: 技术把“抬高”的隐喻带入新媒介：对比度、亮度与降噪把图案抬到背景之上。这个名词命名处理步骤，而非原物的改变。

senses.title: Increase in price or worth
senses.definition: the increase in the financial or market value of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物在财务或市场价值上的增加
senses.example: The certification led to a measurable enhancement in the property's value.
senses.exampleCN: 这项认证使该房产价值有了可测量的提升。
senses.why: This sense is the most literal economic descendant of 'make higher': the number goes up. It is common in finance and real estate, where enhancement must be distinguished from mere inflation.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是“使更高”最字面的经济后裔：数字上升。它在金融与房地产中常见，此时 enhancement 必须与单纯的通货膨胀区分。

senses.title: Technological or biological augmentation
senses.definition: the addition of a capability beyond the original design, as in gene enhancement or cognitive enhancement
senses.definitionCN: 在原本设计之外增加能力，如基因增强或认知增强
senses.example: Debate continues over the ethics of cognitive enhancement in healthy adults.
senses.exampleCN: 关于健康成年人认知增强的伦理争论仍在继续。
senses.why: Modern usage pushes the word past 'improvement' into 'adding capacity that was not there'. This is why enhancement can be ethically contested: it changes the baseline rather than restoring it.
senses.whyCN: 现代用法把词从“改进”推到“增加原本没有的能力”。这也是 enhancement 会引发伦理争议的原因：它改变基线，而不是恢复基线。

senses.title: Performance enhancement in sport
senses.definition: the improvement of athletic performance, especially through prohibited substances or methods
senses.definitionCN: 运动表现的提升，尤指通过被禁物质或方法
senses.example: The athlete was banned for using a performance enhancement substance.
senses.exampleCN: 这名运动员因使用提高成绩的物质被禁赛。
senses.why: Sport gives the word a contested edge: the same enhancement that is admirable in training is scandalous when chemical. The noun shifts from the result to the method that produced it.
senses.whyCN: 体育给这个词一个有争议的锋芒：训练中的增强值得赞赏，化学手段的增强却是丑闻。这个名词从结果转向产生结果的方法。

senses.title: A sentencing enhancement in law
senses.titleCN: 法律中的量刑加重情节
senses.definition: a factor that increases the severity of a penalty beyond the base sentence
senses.definitionCN: 在基础刑罚之上增加处罚严厉程度的因素
senses.example: The use of a weapon was a sentencing enhancement in the case.
senses.exampleCN: 使用武器在该案中是量刑加重情节。
senses.why: Law's 'enhancement' is not improvement at all: it raises the penalty. The word keeps its structural meaning — make higher — while the value becomes negative, a reminder that the metaphor is neutral.
senses.whyCN: 法律里的 enhancement 根本不是“改进”：它抬高的是处罚。这个词保留结构义“使更高”，而价值变为负面，提醒我们隐喻本身是中性的。

senses.title: Environmental or habitat improvement
senses.definition: work that improves the condition of an ecosystem or a habitat for wildlife
senses.definitionCN: 改善生态系统或野生动物栖息地状况的工作
senses.example: Wetland enhancement restored nesting sites without changing the water regime.
senses.exampleCN: 湿地改善恢复了巢址，却没有改变水位制度。
senses.why: Ecology distinguishes enhancement from restoration: enhancement makes a place better for a chosen purpose, while restoration tries to return it to a former state. The noun therefore implies a human goal, not a natural baseline.
senses.whyCN: 生态学区分 enhancement 与 restoration：enhancement 为特定目的让地方变好，restoration 试图回到从前状态。因此这个名词暗示人的目标，而非自然基线。

intro.en: Enhancement is enhance + -ment. Enhance entered English from Old French enhaucier 'to make higher', from Vulgar Latin *inaltiare, a reconstruction built on Latin altus 'high'. The word's first job was physical elevation; its modern jobs are value, quality, and capability.
intro.cn: enhancement 是 enhance + -ment。enhance 从古法语 enhaucier“使更高”进入英语，源自通俗拉丁语 *inaltiare，这是建立在拉丁语 altus“高”上的重构形式。这个词最初的工作是物理抬高，现代的工作则是价值、质量与能力。

items.en: Latin altus meant 'high, deep'. It is the source of altitude and exalt. Vulgar Latin formed *inaltiare 'to raise' by adding in- to altus; the starred form is a reconstruction, not an attested written word.
items.cn: 拉丁语 altus 意为“高、深”，是 altitude 与 exalt 的来源。通俗拉丁语给 altus 加 in- 构成 *inaltiare“抬高”；带星号的形式是重构，而非有文献记录的词。

items.en: Old French enhaucier 'to raise, make higher' derived from that Vulgar Latin verb. English borrowed it in the thirteenth century as enhance, originally with the physical sense of raising something up.
items.cn: 古法语 enhaucier“抬高、使更高”源自那个通俗拉丁语动词。英语于 13 世纪借入为 enhance，最初是物理意义上的“举起”。

items.en: The physical sense weakened and the word moved to value: to enhance a price, a reputation, or a quality. The noun enhancement appears in the sixteenth century with this abstract sense.
items.cn: 物理义减弱，词转向价值：抬高价格、声誉或品质。名词 enhancement 于 16 世纪以这一抽象义出现。

items.en: Photography and later digital imaging adopted enhancement for processing that makes detail clearer. The word names the step, not a change in the scene itself.
items.cn: 摄影及后来的数字成像采用 enhancement 指使细节更清晰的处理。这个词命名处理步骤，而非场景本身的改变。

items.en: Sentencing enhancement became a fixed legal phrase, while performance enhancement became a sports term tied to doping rules. Both keep the structural sense 'make higher' with a negative value.
items.cn: 量刑加重情节成为固定法律短语，而成绩提升成为与反兴奋剂规则相关的体育术语。两者都保留结构义“使更高”，但价值为负。

items.en: Cognitive and genetic enhancement shifted the word from 'repair' to 'augmentation', raising the question of what counts as a normal baseline. The debate is recent; the word's core is not.
items.cn: 认知与基因增强把词从“修复”推向“增益”，引出“何为正常基线”的问题。争论是晚近的，词的核心则不是。

note.en: The first group separates same-family forms from one another; the second group separates improvement from neighbouring ideas of increase and restoration.
note.cn: 第一组区分同词族的不同形式；第二组区分“提升”与相邻的“增加”“恢复”等概念。

entries.definition: to raise the quality or value of something. It is the verb that -ment nominalizes.
entries.definitionCN: 提高某物的质量或价值。它是被 -ment 名词化的动词。

entries.definition: a substance or device that increases an effect. The -er suffix marks the cause, while enhancement names the process or result.
entries.definitionCN: 增强效果的物或装置。-er 后缀标记原因，而 enhancement 命名过程或结果。

entries.definition: made greater or better. It describes the state after enhancement, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 被增强的；提高的。它描述增强之后的状态，而非行为。

entries.definition: the process of becoming better. It is broader and less technical than enhancement, which often implies adding strength or value to an existing base.
entries.definitionCN: 变好的过程。它比 enhancement 更宽泛、更少技术色彩，后者常暗示在既有基础上增加强度或价值。

entries.definition: a rise in amount or number. Increase is neutral about quality; enhancement almost always implies making something better, not merely bigger.
entries.definitionCN: 数量或数额的上升。increase 对质量中性；enhancement 几乎总暗示变好，而不只是变大。

entries.definition: the act of bringing something back to an earlier condition. Enhancement aims at a better future state, restoration at a past one.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物回到较早状态。enhancement 指向更好的未来状态，restoration 指向过去状态。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: Old French enhaucier, Latin altus 'high', the contrast with increase and improve, and modern phrases such as image enhancement and performance enhancement.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：古法语 enhaucier、拉丁语 altus“高”、与 increase、improve 的对照，以及 image enhancement、performance enhancement 等现代说法。

normal.en: enhance goes back to 'make higher': the ancestor is Latin altus 'high', the same root as altitude.
normal.cn: enhance 上溯“使更高”：祖先是拉丁语 altus“高”，与 altitude 同根。

normal.en: Enhancement is enhance + -ment, so the noun can mean either the act or a countable improvement item.
normal.cn: enhancement 是 enhance + -ment，因此名词既可指行为，也可指可数的改进项。

normal.en: Image enhancement raises contrast, not reality: the scene is processed, not rebuilt.
normal.cn: 图像增强抬高的是对比度，不是现实：场景被处理，而非重建。

normal.en: In law an enhancement makes a penalty higher, proving the word's core is 'raise', not 'improve'.
normal.cn: 法律中的 enhancement 抬高的是处罚，证明词的核心是“抬高”，而不是“变好”。

normal.en: Distinguish enhancement from increase: one adds value, the other adds amount.
normal.cn: 把 enhancement 与 increase 区分：一个加价值，一个加数量。

abstract.en: A lamp turned brighter does not change the room; it changes what the room allows you to see.
abstract.cn: 台灯调亮不改变房间，只改变房间允许你看见什么。

abstract.en: Enhancement always has a purpose, and therefore a judge: better for what, and for whom?
abstract.cn: 增强总有目的，因此总有裁判：为了什么更好，对谁更好？

abstract.en: Raising a baseline is not the same as restoring it; that difference is where the ethics live.
abstract.cn: 抬高基线与恢复基线不是一回事；伦理就住在这个差别里。

examples.en: The new lighting produced a striking enhancement of the gallery's interior.
examples.cn: 新照明让画廊内部有了显著的提升。

examples.en: Contrast enhancement made the scanned text readable again.
examples.cn: 对比度增强让扫描的文字重新可读。

examples.en: The court applied a sentencing enhancement because a weapon was used.
examples.cn: 由于使用了武器，法院适用了量刑加重情节。

dict_mnemonic.text: “因汉斯，门特”——因为汉斯把灯调高了一档，门特看见了细节 → enhancement 提升、增强

root: en-（使）+ 古法语 enhaucier“使更高”（通俗拉丁语 *inaltiare < 拉丁语 altus“高”）+ -ment（行为／结果名词后缀）；字面义“抬高”，核心是“在原有基础上增加质量、价值或能力”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of enhancement all raise something above its previous level: quality, an added feature, image detail, market value, human capability, athletic performance, a legal penalty, a habitat's condition. The core metaphor stays 'make higher' even when the raised thing is a punishment.
sensesIntro.cn: enhancement 的八个义项都把某物抬到此前的水平之上：质量、附加功能、图像细节、市场价值、人的能力、运动表现、法律处罚、栖息地状况。即使被抬高的是处罚，核心隐喻仍是“使更高”。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dial turned up one notch — the same scene, but more of it becomes perceptible.
core.cn: 核心意象：旋钮向上拧一档——场景未变，但更多部分变得可感知。

branches.en: QUALITY: a general improvement, and the countable items a release note or renovation can list.
branches.cn: 质量：总体提升，以及发布说明或翻新清单上可列出的具体项。

branches.en: PERCEPTION AND PERFORMANCE: processing lifts image detail, while drugs or training lift athletic output.
branches.cn: 感知与表现：处理抬高图像细节，药物或训练抬高运动产出。

branches.en: VALUE: the number attached to a property or reputation rises in the market.
branches.cn: 价值：房产或声誉的市场数字上升。

branches.en: CAPACITY AND HABITAT: a new capability is added beyond the design, or a place is made better for a chosen species.
branches.cn: 能力与栖息地：在设计之外增加新能力，或为选定物种改善一地。

branches.en: LAW: the same 'raise' structure increases a penalty, showing the metaphor's neutrality.
branches.cn: 法律：同样的“抬高”结构增加处罚，显示隐喻的中性。

intro.en: Enhancement is an English -ment noun on a French verb whose Latin base is altus 'high'. The affix set shows the verb, its participles, the agent noun, and the key contrast words increase and improve.
intro.cn: enhancement 是在法语动词上的英语 -ment 名词，其拉丁底座是 altus“高”。词缀组展示动词、分词、施动名词，以及关键对照词 increase 与 improve。

latinIntro.en: The line runs from Latin altus 'high' through the reconstructed Vulgar Latin *inaltiare 'to raise' to Old French enhaucier and English enhance. The -ment suffix is Latin -mentum, naming means or result.
latinIntro.cn: 这条线从拉丁语 altus“高”经重构的通俗拉丁语 *inaltiare“抬高”到古法语 enhaucier，再到英语 enhance。-ment 后缀是拉丁语 -mentum，命名手段或结果。

items.meaning: the act of raising quality or value
items.meaningCN: 提升；增强（-ment 表行为或结果）
items.example: The enhancement of the park took two summers.
items.exampleCN: 公园的提升用了两个夏天。

items.meaning: to raise in quality, value, or strength
items.meaningCN: 提升；增强（源自“使更高”）
items.example: Plants enhance the air quality of a room.
items.exampleCN: 植物提升室内空气质量。

items.meaningCN: 增强的；提高的（-ed 分词）
items.example: The enhanced image shows the faint lines.
items.exampleCN: 增强后的图像显出微弱线条。

items.meaning: a substance or device that increases an effect
items.meaningCN: 增强剂；增强器（-er 表施动者）
items.example: Flavor enhancers change how food tastes.
items.exampleCN: 增味剂改变食物的味道。

items.meaningCN: 增强性的（-ing 分词形容词）
items.example: The law has an enhancing effect on trust.
items.exampleCN: 这项法律有增强信任的作用。

items.meaningCN: 海拔；高度（altus + -itude）
items.example: The plane climbed to a high altitude.
items.exampleCN: 飞机爬升到高空。

items.meaningCN: 高举；赞扬（ex- + altus）
items.example: The poem exalts the early settlers.
items.exampleCN: 这首诗赞颂早期拓荒者。

items.meaningCN: 改进（不同词源，勿与 enhance 混同）
items.example: The edits improved the clarity of the report.
items.exampleCN: 这些修改提高了报告的清晰度。

definition_zh: 丰富；充实；使富裕；营养强化；铀浓缩；土壤改良；文化充实；（动物福利）环境丰富化；（数据）数据增强
definition_en: the act of making something richer in content, nutrients, or value; the increase of wealth; the addition of nutrients to food; the raising of the concentration of a substance such as uranium; the improvement of soil or culture; (animal welfare) the provision of stimuli in a captive environment; (data) the addition of extra information or variation
core_image: 一片原本单调的草地被种上不同层次的植物：同样的面积，能容纳的生命变多了
scene: 动物园饲养员把食物藏进不同质地的玩具里，让猩猩花一整天去寻找。The keeper hides food in toys of different textures so the ape can search all day: environmental enrichment.
sceneCN: 这里 enrichment 是「环境丰富化」（第 8 个义项：为圈养动物提供刺激与变化）；句意：饲养员把食物藏进不同质地的玩具，让猩猩花一整天寻找，这叫环境丰富化。图中可辨识物件：玩具、藏起的食物、猩猩、围栏内的攀爬架。

pos.zh: 丰富；充实；使富裕（不可数，指过程；可数时指具体丰富措施）
营养强化；浓缩；土壤改良；环境丰富化；数据增强（专业义）

senses.title: Making content richer
senses.definition: the act of adding depth, variety, or interest to something
senses.definitionCN: 为某物增加深度、多样性或趣味的行为
senses.example: The editor's suggestions led to a real enrichment of the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 编辑的建议让论证真正丰富了起来。
senses.why: Enrichment is enrich + -ment, and enrich is en- 'make' + rich. Rich comes from Old English rice and Old French riche, from a Frankish word for 'powerful'. The noun names the act of adding wealth of some kind.
senses.whyCN: enrichment 是 enrich + -ment，而 enrich 是 en-“使”+ rich。rich 来自古英语 rice 与古法语 riche，源头是法兰克语中表“有权势”的词。这个名词命名的是增加某种“财富”的行为。

senses.title: Increasing wealth
senses.definition: the process of making a person, group, or country wealthier
senses.definitionCN: 使人、群体或国家更富有的过程
senses.example: The discovery enriched the region, and the enrichment was visible within a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 这一发现让该地区富裕起来，财富的增加十年内就看得见。
senses.why: This is the most literal sense: money and assets increase. Because the root rich originally meant 'powerful', the word carries a faint memory that wealth and power arrive together.
senses.whyCN: 这是最字面的义项：金钱与资产增加。由于词根 rich 原意是“有权势”，这个词隐约记得财富与权力是一起到来的。

senses.title: Adding nutrients to food
senses.definition: the addition of vitamins, minerals, or other nutrients to a food product
senses.definitionCN: 向食品中添加维生素、矿物质或其他营养素
senses.example: Flour enrichment replaced some nutrients lost in milling.
senses.exampleCN: 面粉营养强化补回了研磨中损失的部分营养素。
senses.why: Nutrition science makes the metaphor technical: the food is made 'richer' in a measurable, listed way. 'Enrichment' differs from 'fortification' in strict usage, though the two are often used loosely.
senses.whyCN: 营养学把这个隐喻技术化：食品以可测量、可列出的方式变得更“富”。严格用法中 enrichment 与 fortification 有别，尽管两者常被混用。

senses.title: Raising the concentration of a substance
senses.definition: the process of increasing the proportion of a desired isotope or component in a material
senses.definitionCN: 提高材料中所需同位素或成分比例的过程
senses.example: Uranium enrichment is the most politically sensitive step in the nuclear fuel cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 铀浓缩是核燃料循环中政治最敏感的一步。
senses.why: Physics uses 'rich' as 'high in a component': enrichment raises the share of U-235. The word describes proportion, not total amount, which is why it can be measured in percentages.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把 rich 理解为“某成分含量高”：浓缩提高铀-235 的比例。这个词描述比例而非总量，因此可以用百分比衡量。

senses.title: Improving soil fertility
senses.definition: the addition of organic matter or nutrients to soil to increase its productivity
senses.definitionCN: 向土壤添加有机物或养分以提高其生产力
senses.example: Compost enrichment restored the degraded field within three seasons.
senses.exampleCN: 堆肥培肥在三个季节内恢复了退化田地。
senses.why: Agriculture applies the same structure to land: the soil becomes richer in the things plants need. The noun can name either the practice or the resulting state.
senses.whyCN: 农业把同一结构用在土地上：土壤在植物所需之物上变得更富。这个名词既可命名做法，也可命名结果状态。

senses.title: Cultural or educational enrichment
senses.definition: the improvement of a person's or community's cultural and intellectual life
senses.definitionCN: 改善个人或社区的文化与智识生活
senses.example: The library's evening lectures are an enrichment of village life.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆的晚间讲座是对乡村生活的充实。
senses.why: This sense measures wealth in experience rather than money. It is common in education, museums, and social policy, where enrichment means widening what people can encounter.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项以经历而非金钱衡量财富。它在教育、博物馆与社会政策中常见，enrichment 指拓宽人们能接触到的东西。

senses.title: Adding information to data
senses.definition: the process of adding extra attributes, context, or variation to a dataset
senses.definitionCN: 为数据集添加额外属性、背景或变异
senses.example: The team's data enrichment added weather and location fields to every record.
senses.exampleCN: 团队的数据补全给每条记录添加了天气与位置字段。
senses.why: In data work, enrichment means joining new fields to existing records so that analysis can ask better questions. In machine learning, it also means increasing variation in training examples.
senses.whyCN: 在数据工作中，enrichment 指给现有记录接上新字段，使分析能提出更好的问题。在机器学习中，它也指增加训练样本的变异。

senses.title: Providing stimuli in captive environments
senses.titleCN: 圈养环境中的环境丰富化
senses.definition: the provision of objects, challenges, and variety that let captive animals express natural behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 提供物品、挑战与变化，使圈养动物能表现自然行为
senses.example: The zoo's enrichment programme reduced pacing in the primates.
senses.exampleCN: 动物园的环境丰富化方案减少了灵长类的刻板踱步。
senses.why: Animal welfare uses the word ethically: the enclosure is not made larger but richer, so that a small space contains more possible behaviours. Enrichment here is about the quality of experience, not quantity of resources.
senses.whyCN: 动物福利从伦理上使用这个词：围栏没有被加大，而是变得“更富”，使小空间包含更多可能行为。这里的 enrichment 关乎体验质量，而非资源数量。

intro.en: Enrichment is enrich + -ment, an English formation on rich. Rich descends from Old English rice and Old French riche, ultimately from a Frankish word meaning 'powerful' (reconstructed as *riki). There is no reliable Latin cognate, which is why the Latin entries for this word are empty.
intro.cn: enrichment 是 enrich + -ment，是在 rich 上的英语构词。rich 来自古英语 rice 与古法语 riche，最终出自法兰克语表“有权势”的词（重构为 *riki）。没有可靠的拉丁同源词，因此这个词的拉丁条目为空。

items.en: The root is the Frankish *riki 'powerful, mighty', a reconstructed form related to German reich 'rich, powerful'. The star marks a reconstruction, not a written record.
items.cn: 词根是法兰克语 *riki“有权势的、强大的”，这是一个重构形式，与德语 reich“富有的、强大的”相关。星号表示重构，而非文献记录。

items.en: Old English rice and Old French riche both meant 'powerful, wealthy'. English has two parallel channels to the same root, which is why rich sits between native and borrowed vocabulary.
items.cn: 古英语 rice 与古法语 riche 都意为“有权势的、富有的”。英语有两条通往同一词根的并行通道，所以 rich 处在本土词与借词之间。

items.en: The verb enrich appears in English in the late fourteenth century, meaning 'to make wealthy' and soon also 'to improve in quality'. The exact first use is uncertain; dictionaries place it in this period.
items.cn: 动词 enrich 于 14 世纪晚期出现在英语中，意为“使富有”，很快也指“提高质量”。确切首用年代来源不确定；词典把它放在这一时期。

items.en: Enrichment appears as the action noun in the sixteenth century. Early examples cover wealth, soil, and the mind, showing that the figurative 'make richer' was available almost immediately.
items.cn: enrichment 于 16 世纪作为动作名词出现。早期例子涵盖财富、土壤与心智，显示比喻性的“使更富”几乎立刻可用。

items.en: Nutrition, nuclear engineering, and soil science each fixed technical senses: nutrient enrichment, uranium enrichment, soil enrichment. In all three the word measures an increased proportion of something valuable.
items.cn: 营养学、核工程与土壤学各自固定了专业义：营养强化、铀浓缩、土壤培肥。三者都用这个词衡量某种有价值成分的比例增加。

items.en: Data enrichment and environmental enrichment are recent expansions: one adds attributes to records, the other adds stimuli to a captive habitat. Both extend 'richer' from money to information and experience.
items.cn: 数据增强与环境丰富化是晚近扩展：一个给记录加属性，一个给圈养栖息地加刺激。两者都把“更富”从金钱扩展到信息与体验。

note.en: The first group separates the rich family from one another; the second group separates enrichment from related ideas of improvement and concentration.
note.cn: 第一组区分 rich 词族内部的关系；第二组区分 enrichment 与相邻的“改进”“浓缩”等概念。

entries.definition: to make richer in money, content, or nutrients. It is the verb that -ment nominalizes.
entries.definitionCN: 使在金钱、内容或营养上更富。它是被 -ment 名词化的动词。

entries.definition: wealthy, or abundant in a quality. It is the adjective at the centre of the family, from Frankish *riki.
entries.definitionCN: 富有的，或某品质丰富的。它是词族中心的形容词，来自法兰克语 *riki。

entries.definition: made richer or strengthened with added nutrients. It describes the state, while enrichment names the process.
entries.definitionCN: 被丰富或强化了营养的。它描述状态，而 enrichment 命名过程。

entries.definition: raising quality or value. It is close to enrichment but does not imply abundance or nutrient content.
entries.definitionCN: 提高质量或价值。它与 enrichment 接近，但不暗示丰足或营养成分。

entries.definition: adding nutrients that were never naturally present, as in fortified cereal. Enrichment usually restores nutrients lost in processing.
entries.definitionCN: 添加原本不天然存在的营养素，如强化麦片。enrichment 通常补回加工中损失的营养素。

entries.definition: increasing the share of a substance in a mixture. It matches the uranium sense but is broader and neutral.
entries.definitionCN: 提高某物质在混合物中的比例。它对应铀浓缩义，但更宽泛、中性。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: en- + rich, the Frankish root *riki, modern phrases such as uranium enrichment and data enrichment, and the animal-welfare term environmental enrichment.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：en- + rich、法兰克语词根 *riki、uranium enrichment 与 data enrichment 等现代说法，以及动物福利术语 environmental enrichment。

normal.en: en- 'make' + rich: enrich literally means 'make rich', and -ment makes it the act.
normal.cn: en-“使”+ rich：enrich 字面就是“使富”，-ment 把它变成行为。

normal.en: Rich goes back to Frankish *riki 'powerful', which is why wealth and power feel connected in this family.
normal.cn: rich 上溯法兰克语 *riki“有权势”，所以这个词族里财富与权力给人相连的感觉。

normal.en: Uranium enrichment raises the proportion of U-235, not the total mass — it is a percentage idea.
normal.cn: 铀浓缩提高的是铀-235 的比例，而非总质量——这是一个百分比概念。

normal.en: Food enrichment puts back what milling removed; fortification adds what was never there.
normal.cn: 食品营养强化补回研磨带走的东西；fortification 添加原本没有的东西。

normal.en: Environmental enrichment gives a captive animal more to do, not a bigger cage.
normal.cn: 环境丰富化给圈养动物更多可做的事，而不是更大的笼子。

abstract.en: Riches are not only money: a rich soil, a rich text, and a rich environment all hold more possibilities per square unit.
abstract.cn: 财富不只是钱：肥沃的土壤、丰富的文本、丰富的环境，每单位都容纳更多可能。

abstract.en: Enrichment is an investment in variety; it pays back as resilience when conditions change.
abstract.cn: 丰富化是对多样性的投资；条件变化时，它以韧性回报。

abstract.en: A concentration is a kind of enrichment that has forgotten the whole: it raises one part by excluding others.
abstract.cn: 浓缩是一种忘了整体的丰富：它靠排除其余来抬高某一部分。

examples.en: The enrichment of the curriculum with primary sources changed how students argued.
examples.cn: 用原始材料充实课程，改变了学生论证的方式。

examples.en: Uranium enrichment is closely monitored under the treaty.
examples.cn: 铀浓缩在该条约下受到严密监督。

examples.en: Keepers use feeding puzzles as enrichment for the big cats.
examples.cn: 饲养员用取食谜题作为大型猫科动物的环境丰富化。

dict_mnemonic.text: “因瑞奇，门特”——因为瑞奇把好东西都装进门里，屋里就富了 → enrichment 丰富、富裕

root: en-（使）+ rich（富有的，古英语 rice / 古法语 riche < 法兰克语 *riki“有权势”）+ -ment（行为／结果名词后缀）；字面义“使富”，核心是“增加某物中有价值的成分或多样性”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of enrichment all increase the amount of something valuable held inside a boundary: money in a household, nutrients in flour, U-235 in uranium, humus in soil, ideas in a life, attributes in a record, stimuli in a cage. The word measures relative richness, not sheer size.
sensesIntro.cn: enrichment 的八个义项都增加某个边界内所持有价值物的量：家庭里的钱、面粉里的营养、铀里的铀-235、土壤里的腐殖质、生活中的观念、记录里的属性、笼子里的刺激。这个词衡量的是相对丰度，而非单纯规模。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a plain field planted in layers — same area, more life held inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片单调的田被分层种植——面积不变，容纳的生命更多。

branches.en: CONTENT AND WEALTH: a text, a mind, a household or a region gains more of what makes it substantial.
branches.cn: 内容与财富：文本、心智、家庭或地区获得更多使其充实的东西。

branches.en: FOOD AND SOIL: nutrients are added back to flour or humus to soil, restoring productive capacity.
branches.cn: 食物与土壤：营养素被补回面粉，腐殖质被加入土壤，恢复生产能力。

branches.en: PROPORTION AND DATA: uranium enrichment and data enrichment both raise the share of a valuable component.
branches.cn: 比例与数据：铀浓缩与数据增强都提高有价值成分的占比。

branches.en: CULTURE: experience itself becomes the wealth, measured by what a person can encounter.
branches.cn: 文化：体验本身成为财富，以一个人能接触到什么来衡量。

branches.en: WELFARE: a captive environment is made richer in possible behaviours rather than larger in area.
branches.cn: 福利：圈养环境在可能行为上变富，而不是在面积上变大。

intro.en: Enrichment is a native English -ment noun on enrich, built on rich from Frankish *riki. Because there is no reliable Latin cognate, the Latin entry list is intentionally empty; the affix set shows the English family and the semantic neighbours instead.
intro.cn: enrichment 是在 enrich 上的英语 -ment 名词，底座 rich 来自法兰克语 *riki。由于没有可靠的拉丁同源词，拉丁条目有意留空；词缀组改为展示英语词族与语义邻居。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate exists for rich: the root is Frankish *riki, reconstructed from comparison with German reich. Latin words for wealth such as dives are semantic equivalents, not relatives, and are therefore not listed.
latinIntro.cn: rich 没有可靠的拉丁同源词：词根是法兰克语 *riki，通过与德语 reich 比较而重构。拉丁语中 dives 等表“富有”的词是语义对应，而非亲属，因此不列入。

items.meaningCN: 丰富；充实（-ment 表行为或结果）
items.example: The enrichment of the soil took three years.
items.exampleCN: 土壤培肥用了三年。

items.meaning: to make richer in money, content, or nutrients
items.meaningCN: 使丰富；使富裕；强化（en- + rich）
items.example: The programme enriches village libraries.
items.exampleCN: 该项目充实乡村图书馆。

items.meaningCN: 富集的；强化的（-ed 分词）
items.example: Enriched flour contains added iron.
items.exampleCN: 强化面粉含添加的铁。

items.meaningCN: 使丰富的；有启发性的（-ing 分词形容词）
items.example: It was an enriching conversation.
items.exampleCN: 那是一次让人充实的谈话。

items.structure: Old English rice / Old French riche < Frankish *riki
items.meaningCN: 富有的；丰富的（词基）
items.example: The soil here is dark and rich.
items.exampleCN: 这里的土壤黑而肥沃。

items.meaning: the state of being rich or abundant
items.meaningCN: 丰富；富饶（-ness 性质名词）
items.example: The richness of the forest surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 森林的丰富让我们惊讶。

items.meaning: in a rich or abundant way
items.meaningCN: 丰富地；富丽地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The hall was richly decorated.
items.exampleCN: 大厅装饰华丽。

items.meaning: a planned set of enriching activities
items.meaningCN: 丰富化方案（复合名词）
items.example: The enrichment programme includes puzzles and scents.
items.exampleCN: 丰富化方案包括谜题与气味。

definition_zh: 自然环境的；生态环境的；周围环境的；环境因素的；环境保护的；环境艺术的
definition_en: relating to the natural world and its condition; relating to a person's or organism's surroundings and conditions; concerned with protecting nature; (biology) arising from external conditions rather than genes; (art) concerned with the experience of a space
core_image: 一圈看不见的膜把人和周围的一切隔开又连上：你呼吸的空气、踩的地、听见的噪声都在这一圈里
scene: 工厂代表指着监测屏上的水质曲线。The plant manager points at the water-quality curve and says the report assesses the environmental impact of the project.
sceneCN: 这里 environmental 是「环境的、环境影响的」（第 1 个义项：与自然环境及其状况相关）；句意：代表指着水质曲线说，这份报告评估项目的环境影响。图中可辨识物件：监测屏、水质曲线、取样瓶、工厂厂区。

pos.zh: 自然环境的；生态环境的；环境保护的（常与 impact / protection / law 连用）
周围环境的；由环境引起的；（艺术）环境艺术的（较专业用法）

senses.title: Relating to the natural world
senses.definition: relating to the natural world, especially its air, water, land, and living systems
senses.definitionCN: 与自然世界相关，尤指空气、水、土地与生命系统
senses.example: The project underwent a full environmental review before construction.
senses.exampleCN: 项目在施工前接受了全面的环境审查。
senses.why: Environmental is environment + -al. Environment is environ + -ment, where environ 'to surround' comes from Old French environ 'around'. The adjective therefore begins with the image of everything that surrounds a living thing.
senses.whyCN: environmental 是 environment + -al。environment 是 environ + -ment，其中 environ“包围”来自古法语 environ“在周围”。因此这个形容词的起点是“包围着生命体的一切”这一意象。

senses.title: Relating to surroundings or conditions
senses.definition: relating to the conditions, objects, and influences that surround a person, organism, or activity
senses.definitionCN: 与包围着人、生物或活动的条件、物体与影响相关
senses.example: Temperature and light are key environmental variables in the experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 温度与光照是实验中的关键环境变量。
senses.why: This is the broader, non-green sense: environment can be a laboratory room or a social setting. The adjective simply says 'of the surroundings', and context decides which surroundings count.
senses.whyCN: 这是更宽、非“环保”的义项：environment 可以是实验室房间或社会环境。形容词只说“周围状况的”，至于算哪些周围，由语境决定。

senses.title: Concerned with protecting nature
senses.definition: relating to efforts, laws, or groups that aim to protect nature from harm
senses.definitionCN: 与旨在保护自然免受损害的努力、法律或团体相关
senses.example: Environmental groups challenged the permit in court.
senses.exampleCN: 环保团体在法庭上质疑该许可。
senses.why: By metonymy the word shifts from 'of the environment' to 'protecting the environment'. This is the dominant everyday sense in news and policy, and it carries an implicit stance rather than a neutral description.
senses.whyCN: 通过转喻，这个词从“环境的”转到“保护环境的”。这是新闻与政策中最主要的日常义，它带有隐含立场，而非中性描述。

senses.title: Relating to environmental health
senses.definition: relating to conditions that affect public health, such as air quality, water safety, and waste
senses.definitionCN: 与影响公共卫生的状况相关，如空气质量、饮水安全与废物
senses.example: The agency investigates environmental health risks in old housing.
senses.exampleCN: 该机构调查老旧住房中的环境卫生风险。
senses.why: Public health uses the adjective to connect illness to place: lead paint, bad air, and contaminated water are environmental exposures. Here nature and human health are measured together.
senses.whyCN: 公共卫生用这个形容词把疾病与地点连起来：含铅涂料、劣质空气与受污染的水都是环境暴露。这里自然与人类健康被一起衡量。

senses.title: Arising from external conditions in biology
senses.titleCN: 生物学中由外部条件引起的
senses.definition: caused by external conditions rather than by genetic inheritance
senses.definitionCN: 由外部条件而非遗传引起
senses.example: The study separated genetic from environmental causes of the disease.
senses.exampleCN: 该研究把这种病的遗传成因与环境成因分开。
senses.why: Biology uses the term in the nature–nurture contrast: environmental effects are everything the genome does not supply. The adjective marks a cause, not a setting, which is why it pairs with 'factors' and 'influences'.
senses.whyCN: 生物学在“先天—后天”对照中使用这个术语：环境效应是基因组未提供的一切。这个形容词标记的是原因，而非场景，所以常与 factors、influences 搭配。

senses.title: Relating to environmental art
senses.definition: relating to art that treats a place, space, or landscape as part of the work
senses.definitionCN: 与把地点、空间或景观作为作品一部分的艺术相关
senses.example: The environmental installation changed how visitors moved through the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 这件环境装置改变了观众在大厅中移动的方式。
senses.why: Art criticism uses 'environmental' for works that surround the viewer rather than hang in front of them. This sense is unrelated to ecology; the shared word is 'surroundings'.
senses.whyCN: 艺术批评用 environmental 指包围观众、而非挂在观众面前的作品。这个义项与生态无关，共享的词义是“周围”。

senses.title: Subject to environmental regulation
senses.definition: governed by rules on pollution, land use, or ecological impact
senses.definitionCN: 受污染、土地使用或生态影响方面的规则约束
senses.example: The plant needs an environmental permit to discharge treated water.
senses.exampleCN: 该厂需要环境许可才能排放处理过的水。
senses.why: Legal usage nominalizes the word into fixed phrases: environmental law, environmental impact assessment, environmental permit. Here the adjective marks a regulatory domain with defined procedures.
senses.whyCN: 法律用法把这个词名物化为固定短语：environmental law、environmental impact assessment、environmental permit。这里形容词标记一个有既定程序的监管领域。

senses.title: Environmentally oriented in design
senses.definition: designed or operated with low harm to the environment in mind
senses.definitionCN: 在设计或运行上以低环境损害为取向
senses.example: The building's environmental features include grey-water reuse and passive cooling.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋建筑的环境友好特性包括中水回用与被动降温。
senses.why: Engineering extends the word to products and buildings: environmental design is design that accounts for resources and emissions. It overlaps with 'green' and 'sustainable' but is more technical and less promotional.
senses.whyCN: 工程学把词扩展到产品与建筑：environmental design 是考虑资源与排放的设计。它与 green、sustainable 重叠，但更技术化、更少宣传色彩。

intro.en: Environmental is environment + -al. Environment is a French-derived noun: environ 'to surround' + -ment. Environ comes from Old French environ 'around', built on viron 'circuit', whose further origin is uncertain. English environmental is a nineteenth-century adjective, and its 'green' sense is largely a twentieth-century development.
intro.cn: environmental 是 environment + -al。environment 是法语来源名词：environ“包围”+ -ment。environ 来自古法语 environ“在周围”，建立在 viron“环、圈”上，更早来源不确定。英语 environmental 是 19 世纪形容词，其“环保”义主要是 20 世纪的发展。

items.en: Old French environ meant 'around, in a circle', from en- 'in' plus viron 'circuit, circle'. The verb environner 'to surround' and the noun environnement developed from it.
items.cn: 古法语 environ 意为“在周围、成圈”，由 en-“在内”加 viron“环、圈”构成。动词 environner“包围”与名词 environnement 由此发展。

items.en: The origin of viron 'circle' is uncertain. It may be linked to virer 'to turn', but the further etymology of virer is itself disputed; no reliable Latin source can be asserted.
items.cn: viron“环、圈”的来源不确定。它可能与 virer“转动”有关，但 virer 的更早词源本身有争议；无法断言可靠的拉丁来源。

items.en: English borrowed environment in the seventeenth century as 'the act of surrounding' and 'surrounding conditions'. The modern sense of natural surroundings consolidated in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
items.cn: 英语于 17 世纪借入 environment，义为“包围的行为”与“周围状况”。自然环境的现代义在 18、19 世纪逐步定型。

items.en: Environmental appears as the adjective of environment in the nineteenth century. Early uses concern surroundings and conditions generally, not pollution or ecology.
items.cn: environmental 于 19 世纪作为 environment 的形容词出现。早期用法泛指周围与条件，而非污染或生态。

items.en: With the rise of ecology and the environmental movement after the mid-twentieth century, the adjective shifted toward nature protection: environmental law, environmental impact, environmental groups.
items.cn: 20 世纪中叶以后，随着生态学与环保运动的兴起，这个形容词转向自然保护：environmental law、environmental impact、environmental groups。

items.en: The word now spans laboratory variables, public health, art installations, and building design. The unifying idea is still 'what surrounds', which is why one adjective can serve ecology and aesthetics at once.
items.cn: 这个词如今覆盖实验室变量、公共卫生、艺术装置与建筑设计。统一的概念仍是“包围着什么”，所以一个形容词能同时服务生态与美学。

note.en: The first group separates the environment family from look-alikes; the second group separates environmental from neighbouring adjectives of nature and surroundings.
note.cn: 第一组区分 environment 词族与形近词；第二组区分 environmental 与相邻的“自然”“周围”形容词。

entries.definition: the surroundings or conditions in which something exists. It is the noun that -al turns into the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 某物存在的周围状况或条件。它是被 -al 转化为形容词的名词。

entries.definition: in a way that relates to or affects the environment, as in environmentally friendly. It modifies an adjective or verb, not a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 以与环境相关或影响环境的方式，如 environmentally friendly。它修饰形容词或动词，而非名词。

entries.definition: to surround or encircle. It is the oldest member of the family and now rare outside 'environment'.
entries.definitionCN: 包围、环绕。它是词族中最古老的成员，如今除 environment 外很少见。

entries.definition: relating to ecology, the study of organisms and their interactions. It is more technical than environmental and not necessarily about protection.
entries.definitionCN: 与生态学相关，即研究生物及其互动。它比 environmental 更技术化，也不一定涉及保护。

entries.definition: existing or happening around something. It is neutral and spatial, while environmental can imply conditions or regulation.
entries.definitionCN: 存在于或发生在某物周围的。它中性且空间化，而 environmental 可暗示条件或法规。

entries.definition: environmentally friendly, often used in marketing. It is looser and more promotional than environmental.
entries.definitionCN: 环保的，常用于营销。它比 environmental 更松、更带宣传色彩。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: environ 'to surround', the -ment noun, the -al adjective, and fixed phrases such as environmental impact and environmental law.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：environ“包围”、-ment 名词、-al 形容词，以及 environmental impact、environmental law 等固定短语。

normal.en: environ means 'to surround': environment is everything that surrounds us, and -al makes it the adjective.
normal.cn: environ 意为“包围”：environment 是包围我们的一切，-al 使它成为形容词。

normal.en: environment + -al: keep the -ment and add -al; the adverb then adds -ly.
normal.cn: environment + -al：保留 -ment 再加 -al；副词再加 -ly。

normal.en: Environmental impact, environmental law, environmental protection: the three phrases cover most news uses.
normal.cn: environmental impact、environmental law、environmental protection：这三个短语覆盖了大部分新闻用法。

normal.en: In biology, environmental means 'caused from outside', the opposite of genetic.
normal.cn: 生物学中 environmental 意为“由外部引起的”，与 genetic 相对。

normal.en: Environmental art surrounds the viewer; it borrows the word's oldest sense of 'surroundings', not its green sense.
normal.cn: 环境艺术包围观众；它借的是这个词最古老的“周围”义，而非环保义。

abstract.en: An environment is not a backdrop but a set of conditions that enter the body with every breath.
abstract.cn: 环境不是背景板，而是一套随每次呼吸进入身体的条件。

abstract.en: To call something environmental is to admit that its causes and effects cross its own boundary.
abstract.cn: 把某事称为 environmental，就是承认它的因果越过了自身边界。

abstract.en: Protection and surroundings share one word because what surrounds us is also what we must defend.
abstract.cn: 保护与周围共享一个词，因为包围我们的事物也是我们必须守护的事物。

examples.en: The environmental impact of the dam was assessed over three years.
examples.cn: 大坝的环境影响经过三年评估。

examples.en: Environmental factors explain part of the difference in height between the groups.
examples.cn: 环境因素解释了各组身高差异的一部分。

examples.en: The city adopted stricter environmental rules on waste water.
examples.cn: 该市对废水采取了更严格的环境规定。

dict_mnemonic.text: “因外绕，门头”——因为外面绕着一圈东西，门口就成了环境 → environmental 环境的

root: environ（包围，古法语 environ“在周围”）+ -ment（名词后缀）+ -al（形容词后缀）；字面义“包围着（我们）的”，核心是“与周围状况或自然世界相关”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of environmental spread outward from one idea: what surrounds a thing. That surrounding can be nature, a laboratory, a body, a genome's absence, a gallery space, a legal regime, or a building's design. The 'green' sense is the most visible today but not the oldest.
sensesIntro.cn: environmental 的八个义项都从一个观念向外展开：包围某物的一切。这个“周围”可以是自然、实验室、身体、基因之外的因素、画廊空间、法律体制或建筑设计。“环保”义今天最显眼，却不是最古老的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an invisible membrane that both separates a living thing from its surroundings and connects it to them.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层看不见的膜，既把生命体与周围隔开，又把它与周围连在一起。

branches.en: WHAT SURROUNDS: the natural world and the laboratory's variables are both the set of conditions around a thing.
branches.cn: 包围之物：自然世界与实验室变量都是某物周围的条件集合。

branches.en: PROTECTION AND HEALTH: the adjective turns from describing surroundings to defending them, and to health effects that enter through them.
branches.cn: 保护与健康：形容词从描述周围转为守护周围，并指向通过周围进入健康的影响。

branches.en: CAUSE: in biology, environmental marks what the genome does not supply.
branches.cn: 原因：生物学中 environmental 标记基因组未提供的东西。

branches.en: ART: the work surrounds the viewer, using the oldest sense of the word.
branches.cn: 艺术：作品包围观众，用的是这个词最古老的义。

branches.en: REGULATION AND DESIGN: law defines the domain, and engineering builds products that lower their load on it.
branches.cn: 法规与设计：法律界定领域，工程建造降低环境负荷的产品。

intro.en: Environmental is a two-suffix adjective: environ + -ment + -al. The affix set shows the noun, adverb, and related forms, and warns that the root viron is of uncertain origin.
intro.cn: environmental 是双后缀形容词：environ + -ment + -al。词缀组展示名词、副词与相关形式，并提醒词根 viron 来源不确定。

latinIntro.en: Old French viron 'circle' and environ 'around' yield the verb environner and the noun environnement; English adds -al. No reliable Latin cognate for viron can be asserted, so the Latin entries are left empty rather than invented.
latinIntro.cn: 古法语 viron“圈”与 environ“在周围”产生动词 environner 与名词 environnement；英语再加 -al。无法断言 viron 有可靠拉丁同源词，因此拉丁条目留空，而不编造。

items.meaning: relating to surroundings or the natural world
items.meaningCN: 环境的；环保的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The environmental review took a year.
items.exampleCN: 环境审查用了一年。

items.meaning: the conditions or surroundings of something
items.meaningCN: 环境；周围状况（environ + -ment）
items.example: Children learn from their environment.
items.exampleCN: 儿童从环境中学习。

items.meaningCN: 在环境方面；环保地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The product is environmentally friendly.
items.exampleCN: 该产品对环境友好。

items.meaning: a movement to protect the natural world
items.meaningCN: 环境保护主义（-ism 表主义）
items.example: Environmentalism grew rapidly in the 1970s.
items.exampleCN: 环保主义在 1970 年代迅速发展。

items.meaning: a person who works to protect nature
items.meaningCN: 环保主义者（-ist 表人）
items.example: Environmentalists opposed the new road.
items.exampleCN: 环保主义者反对这条新路。

items.meaningCN: 包围；环绕（古法语 environ）
items.example: Trees environ the old house.
items.exampleCN: 树木环绕着这座老房子。

items.meaning: the effect of an activity on the surroundings
items.meaningCN: 环境影响（复合名词）
items.example: The environmental impact was rated low.
items.exampleCN: 环境影响被评为低。

items.meaning: the body of rules protecting the natural world
items.meaningCN: 环境法（复合名词）
items.example: Environmental law governs waste disposal.
items.exampleCN: 环境法规范废物处置。

definition_zh: 在环境方面；环保地；以对环境无害的方式；就周围环境而言；从环境影响角度看；由环境引起地
definition_en: in relation to the natural environment; in a way that protects or harms the environment; with respect to surrounding conditions; from the standpoint of environmental impact; as caused by external conditions
core_image: 一只手把垃圾分成两堆，又把可回收的那堆送进循环箱：同一个动作，结果分到两个未来
scene: 顾客自带杯子买咖啡。The customer brings a cup for coffee, and the barista says this way of ordering is more environmentally friendly.
sceneCN: 这里 environmentally 是「环保地、对环境友好地」（第 2 个义项：以保护环境的方式）；句意：顾客自带杯子买咖啡，店员说这样点单对环境更友好。图中可辨识物件：自带杯、咖啡机、循环使用标识、店员的手。

pos.zh: 在环境方面；环保地（修饰形容词或动词，如 environmentally friendly）

collocations.zh: 环境无害的；环境上可靠的

senses.title: In relation to the natural environment
senses.definition: in a way that relates to the natural world and its condition
senses.definitionCN: 以与自然世界及其状况相关的方式
senses.example: The two proposals should be compared environmentally, not only financially.
senses.exampleCN: 这两项提案应比较其环境方面，而不仅是财务方面。
senses.why: Environmentally is environmental + -ly, where -ly comes from Old English -lice. The adverb puts the adjective into the frame 'with respect to X': it does not describe an action's manner so much as the dimension on which it is judged.
senses.whyCN: environmentally 是 environmental + -ly，其中 -ly 来自古英语 -lice。这个副词把形容词放进“就 X 而言”的框架：它与其说描述动作方式，不如说指示评判的维度。

senses.title: In a way that protects nature
senses.definition: in a manner that reduces harm to or improves the natural environment
senses.definitionCN: 以减少对自然环境的损害或改善自然环境的方式
senses.example: The building is heated environmentally, using solar gain and ground-source heat.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋建筑用太阳能得热与地源热来供暖，方式是环保的。
senses.why: This is the everyday 'green' use, fixed in the phrase environmentally friendly. The adverb modifies an adjective and signals a value judgment: the action is measured against its ecological cost.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常的“环保”用法，固定在 environmentally friendly 短语中。副词修饰形容词并传递价值判断：该行为要按生态代价来衡量。

senses.title: With respect to surroundings
senses.definition: in relation to the surrounding conditions of a place, organism, or system
senses.definitionCN: 与某地点、生物或系统的周围条件相关
senses.example: The species is environmentally adapted to cold, wet summers.
senses.exampleCN: 该物种在环境上适应寒冷潮湿的夏季。
senses.why: This sense is neutral and scientific: the surroundings can be a climate or a laboratory chamber. The adverb marks the dimension of adaptation, not a moral claim about protecting nature.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项中性而科学：周围可以是气候或实验舱。副词标记的是适应维度，而不是保护自然的道德主张。

senses.title: From the standpoint of impact
senses.definition: judged by the effect an action has on the environment
senses.definitionCN: 按某行为对环境造成的效果来评判
senses.example: The route is environmentally expensive because it cuts through a wetland.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路线在环境上代价高昂，因为它穿过湿地。
senses.why: Here the adverb introduces a cost-benefit frame: the environment becomes one column in an evaluation. It often pairs with expensive, costly, damaging, or beneficial.
senses.whyCN: 这里副词引入成本—收益框架：环境成为评估中的一栏。它常与 expensive、costly、damaging、beneficial 搭配。

senses.title: As caused by external conditions
senses.definition: as produced by surrounding conditions rather than by genes or internal causes
senses.definitionCN: 由周围条件而非基因或内部原因造成
senses.example: The disorder is environmentally triggered but genetically predisposed.
senses.exampleCN: 这种障碍由环境触发，但有遗传易感性。
senses.why: Biology uses the adverb to assign causation: an environmentally induced effect comes from outside the organism. The word marks a cause, not a setting, which is why it can stand before induced or triggered.
senses.whyCN: 生物学用这个副词来归因：environmentally induced 的效应来自生物体之外。这个词标记原因而非场景，所以能放在 induced、triggered 之前。

senses.title: In environmental design terms
senses.definition: in terms of how a building, product, or space is designed to relate to its surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 就建筑、产品或空间如何与其周围发生关系的设计而言
senses.example: The pavilion was environmentally designed to shade its own courtyard.
senses.exampleCN: 这座亭子在环境设计上是为了给自己的庭院遮阴。
senses.why: Design usage keeps both senses at once: the surroundings are physical, and the aim is low impact. The adverb describes an integrated approach rather than a single green feature.
senses.whyCN: 设计用法同时保留两层：周围是物理的，目标是低影响。副词描述的是一种整合方法，而非单一环保功能。

senses.title: In regulatory terms
senses.definition: in terms of environmental law, permits, or official standards
senses.definitionCN: 就环境法、许可或官方标准而言
senses.example: The site is environmentally compliant but socially contested.
senses.exampleCN: 该场址在环境法规上是合规的，但在社会层面有争议。
senses.why: Law and compliance use the adverb to locate a claim inside a regulatory frame: compliant, permitted, approved. The environment becomes a set of standards rather than a physical place.
senses.whyCN: 法律与合规用这个副词把主张放进监管框架：compliant、permitted、approved。环境变成一套标准，而非一个物理场所。

senses.title: From an ecological viewpoint in an argument
senses.definition: speaking from an ecological point of view, often to introduce a contrast
senses.definitionCN: 从生态观点出发说话，常引出对照
senses.example: Environmentally, the plan is sound; economically, it is fragile.
senses.exampleCN: 从环境角度看，该计划可靠；从经济角度看，它很脆弱。
senses.why: Sentence-initial use makes the adverb a frame-setter, like 'economically' or 'technically'. It tells the listener which dimension the next claim is measured on, and it often sets up a contrast with another dimension.
senses.whyCN: 置于句首时，这个副词是框架设定语，类似 economically、technically。它告诉听者接下来的主张按哪个维度衡量，且常与另一个维度形成对照。

intro.en: Environmentally is environmental + -ly. Environmental is environment + -al, and environment is environ 'to surround' + -ment, from Old French environ 'around'. The adverb's -ly goes back to Old English -lice, so this is a layered English construction on a French-derived noun of uncertain deeper origin.
intro.cn: environmentally 是 environmental + -ly。environmental 是 environment + -al，而 environment 是 environ“包围”+ -ment，来自古法语 environ“在周围”。副词后缀 -ly 上溯古英语 -lice，因此这是一个在法语来源名词上层层构成的英语派生词，其更深词源不确定。

items.en: Old French environ 'around' came from en- 'in' plus viron 'circuit'. The verb environner 'to surround' produced the noun environnement.
items.cn: 古法语 environ“在周围”来自 en-“在内”加 viron“环、圈”。动词 environner“包围”产生名词 environnement。

items.en: The deeper origin of viron is uncertain; a link with virer 'to turn' is plausible but the etymology of virer is itself disputed. No reliable Latin source is asserted here.
items.cn: viron 的更早来源不确定；与 virer“转动”的联系有可能，但 virer 的词源本身有争议。此处不断言可靠的拉丁来源。

items.en: English environment entered in the seventeenth century and settled into the modern sense of surrounding conditions by the nineteenth. Environmental followed as its adjective.
items.cn: 英语 environment 于 17 世纪进入，到 19 世纪定型为“周围状况”的现代义。environmental 随后作为其形容词出现。

items.en: The adverb environmentally is a straightforward -ly formation on environmental. Its early uses concern surroundings generally, not ecology.
items.cn: 副词 environmentally 是在 environmental 上的直接 -ly 构成。其早期用法泛指周围，而非生态。

items.en: After the mid-twentieth century the adverb attached to 'friendly', 'sound', and 'sustainable', becoming a standard way to praise low ecological impact. The exact first appearance of environmentally friendly is uncertain.
items.cn: 20 世纪中叶以后，这个副词与 friendly、sound、sustainable 结合，成为称赞低生态影响的标准说法。environmentally friendly 的确切首现年代来源不确定。

items.en: Today the adverb works as a dimension marker in arguments: environmentally, economically, socially. That frame-setting use is the most abstract extension of 'surroundings'.
items.cn: 今天这个副词在论证中充当维度标记：environmentally、economically、socially。这种框架设定用法是“周围”最抽象的延伸。

note.en: The first group separates the environment family by suffix; the second group separates adverbs that also mark a dimension or manner.
note.cn: 第一组按后缀区分 environment 词族；第二组区分同样标记维度或方式的其他副词。

entries.definition: relating to the environment. It is the adjective that -ly turns into this adverb.
entries.definitionCN: 与环境相关的。它是被 -ly 转化为该副词的形容词。

entries.definition: the surroundings or conditions of something. It is the noun at the base of the whole family.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的周围状况或条件。它是整个词族底部的名词。

entries.definition: the movement or belief in protecting nature. The -ism suffix marks a doctrine, not a manner.
entries.definitionCN: 保护自然的运动或信念。-ism 后缀标记学说，而非方式。

entries.definition: from the standpoint of ecology as a science. It is more technical and less value-laden than environmentally.
entries.definitionCN: 从作为科学的生态学角度。它比 environmentally 更技术化、更少价值色彩。

entries.definition: in an environmentally friendly way. It is rare and informal, while environmentally is standard in policy and advertising.
entries.definitionCN: 以环保的方式。它罕用且口语化，而 environmentally 是政策与广告中的标准词。

entries.definition: in a way that does not exhaust resources. It stresses long-term use, while environmentally stresses ecological effect.
entries.definitionCN: 以不耗尽资源的方式。它强调长期使用，而 environmentally 强调生态影响。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: environment + -al + -ly, the fixed phrase environmentally friendly, and the sentence-initial frame 'environmentally, economically, socially'.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：environment + -al + -ly、固定短语 environmentally friendly，以及句首框架 environmentally、economically、socially。

normal.en: environment + -al + -ly: three suffixes stacked, each doing one job.
normal.cn: environment + -al + -ly：三个后缀叠加，各做一件事。

normal.en: -ly comes from Old English -lice, so the adverb layer is native even though the noun is French.
normal.cn: -ly 来自古英语 -lice，所以尽管名词是法语来源，副词层是本土的。

normal.en: Environmentally friendly is the phrase you will meet most; learn it as a unit.
normal.cn: environmentally friendly 是最常遇到的短语；把它当作一个整体记住。

normal.en: At the start of a sentence, environmentally picks the dimension of judgment, like economically or technically.
normal.cn: 在句首，environmentally 选定评判维度，类似 economically 或 technically。

normal.en: In biology, environmentally induced means the cause came from outside the organism.
normal.cn: 生物学中 environmentally induced 指原因来自生物体之外。

abstract.en: A dimension word does not describe; it decides what counts as success in the next clause.
abstract.cn: 维度词不描述，而是决定下一分句中什么算成功。

abstract.en: Surroundings enter the ledger twice: as a place to protect and as a cost to be counted.
abstract.cn: 周围在账本上出现两次：作为要保护的地方，也作为要计入的成本。

abstract.en: Doing something environmentally is doing it with the boundary of the system in view.
abstract.cn: 以环境方式做事，就是把系统的边界纳入视野。

examples.en: The packaging is environmentally friendly and can be composted at home.
examples.cn: 这种包装对环境友好，可在家堆肥。

examples.en: Environmentally, the dam is the costlier option; economically, it is the cheaper one.
examples.cn: 从环境角度看，大坝代价更高；从经济角度看，它更便宜。

examples.en: The crop's yield is environmentally limited by rainfall rather than by soil.
examples.cn: 该作物的产量受降雨而非土壤的环境限制。

dict_mnemonic.text: “因外绕，门头，利”——因为外面绕着门头的那圈东西有利，就要环保 → environmentally 在环境方面

root: environ（包围，古法语“在周围”）+ -ment（名词）+ -al（形容词）+ -ly（副词，古英语 -lice）；字面义“以包围着我们的一切为参照”，核心是“从环境这一维度”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of environmentally all select a dimension rather than describe a manner: natural condition, protection, surroundings, impact, external cause, design, regulation, or argumentative frame. The word tells the listener how the next claim is to be measured.
sensesIntro.cn: environmentally 的八个义项都在选定一个维度，而非描述方式：自然状况、保护、周围、影响、外部原因、设计、法规或论证框架。这个词告诉听者接下来的主张按什么衡量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pair of sorting hands that send one object into the recycling stream and another into waste — one action, two futures.
core.cn: 核心意象：一双分拣的手，把一个物件送进回收流，把另一个送进垃圾流——一个动作，两个未来。

branches.en: DIMENSION: a comparison, adaptation, or judgment is made with respect to the surroundings.
branches.cn: 维度：比较、适应或判断是就周围状况作出的。

branches.en: VALUE: the same dimension becomes a moral or cost judgment, praising low harm or counting high cost.
branches.cn: 价值：同一维度变成道德或成本判断，称赞低损害或计入高代价。

branches.en: CAUSE: in biology, the adverb assigns an external cause rather than a setting.
branches.cn: 原因：生物学中这个副词指派外部原因，而非场景。

branches.en: DESIGN AND LAW: the dimension is built into a product or fixed in a permit and a standard.
branches.cn: 设计与法律：这一维度被做进产品，或被固定在许可与标准中。

branches.en: FRAME: sentence-initial use sets the dimension for the whole claim, often in contrast with another.
branches.cn: 框架：句首用法为整个主张设定维度，常与另一维度对照。

intro.en: Environmentally is the adverb layer of a three-suffix family. The affix set shows the noun, adjective, adverb, doctrine, and person nouns, with -ly traced to Old English -lice.
intro.cn: environmentally 是一个三后缀词族的副词层。词缀组展示名词、形容词、副词、学说名词与人名词，并把 -ly 追溯到古英语 -lice。

latinIntro.en: Old French viron 'circle' and environ 'around' give the noun environment; English adds -al and then -ly. The deeper root of viron is uncertain, so no Latin entries are asserted.
latinIntro.cn: 古法语 viron“圈”与 environ“在周围”给出名词 environment；英语再加 -al 与 -ly。viron 的更早词根不确定，因此不断言拉丁条目。

items.meaningCN: 在环境方面；环保地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The process is environmentally safe.
items.exampleCN: 该过程在环境上是安全的。

items.meaningCN: 环境的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: Environmental rules are stricter now.
items.exampleCN: 环境规定现在更严格。

items.meaningCN: 环境（environ + -ment）
items.example: The environment shapes behaviour.
items.exampleCN: 环境塑造行为。

items.meaningCN: 环境保护主义（-ism 表主义）
items.example: Environmentalism shaped the party's platform.
items.exampleCN: 环保主义塑造了该党的纲领。

items.meaningCN: 环保主义者（-ist 表人）
items.example: Environmentalists welcomed the ruling.
items.exampleCN: 环保主义者欢迎该裁决。

items.meaningCN: 包围（古法语 environ）
items.example: Hills environ the valley.
items.exampleCN: 群山环绕山谷。

items.meaningCN: 对环境友好的（复合形容词）
items.example: The detergent is environmentally friendly.
items.exampleCN: 这种洗涤剂对环境友好。

items.meaningCN: 环境敏感的（复合形容词）
items.example: The area is environmentally sensitive.
items.exampleCN: 该地区环境敏感。

definition_zh: 平等；相等；均等；（数学）等式、相等关系；（法律）法律面前平等；机会平等；性别、种族平等
definition_en: the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, or opportunities; the condition of being the same in amount or value; (mathematics) the relation expressed by an equation; fairness of treatment before the law
core_image: 一架调平的天平：两端的托盘不同，却停在同一条水平线上
scene: 招聘主管把两份同一岗位的录用条件并排摊开。The hiring manager lays two offers for the same post side by side and says the pay should show equality between men and women.
sceneCN: 这里 equality 是「平等」（第 1 个义项：在地位、权利上相等）；句意：主管把两份同岗位的录用条件并排摊开，说男女应聘者的待遇应体现平等。图中可辨识物件：两份合同、同一条薪水数字、天平图标、主管的手。

pos.zh: 平等；相等（不可数，指状态或原则）
（数学）等式、相等关系（可数，指具体的等式）

collocations.zh: A 与 B 之间的平等

forms.label: 复数（多种平等／多个等式）

senses.title: Equal status or rights
senses.definition: the state in which people have the same status, rights, or treatment
senses.definitionCN: 人们拥有相同地位、权利或待遇的状态
senses.example: The charter demands equality for all citizens regardless of origin.
senses.exampleCN: 宪章要求所有公民不论出身一律平等。
senses.why: Equality is equal + -ity. Equal comes from Latin aequalis 'uniform, even', from aequus 'level, fair'. The noun suffix -itas names a state, so equality is literally 'the state of being level'.
senses.whyCN: equality 是 equal + -ity。equal 来自拉丁语 aequalis“均一的、平的”，源自 aequus“平的、公平的”。名词后缀 -itas 命名状态，所以 equality 字面就是“处于水平状态”。

senses.title: Sameness in amount or value
senses.definition: the condition of being the same in size, amount, or value
senses.definitionCN: 在大小、数量或价值上相同
senses.example: The equality of the two weights kept the beam horizontal.
senses.exampleCN: 两个砝码重量相等，使横梁保持水平。
senses.why: The physical sense is the oldest: two quantities balance. The word does not say they are identical in every respect, only that they are level on the dimension being measured.
senses.whyCN: 物理义最古老：两个量达到平衡。这个词并不说它们在各方面完全相同，只说在被测量的维度上齐平。

senses.title: A mathematical equation
